GraceChangeDesignContext.Rationale: This package converts audit finding F08, the false-abstraction analysis, and the proposed ADR into durable architecture authority. Strategy C preserves portability of scenarios and data without forcing the weakest common engine API.

Alternatives.Alternative: Chromium-first strategy A remains a fallback if the portable layer repeatedly blocks valuable CEF integration.
Full Chromium and Firefox parity strategy B is rejected until a second maintained runtime and demand justify its cost.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: Exact engine-extension namespaces and compatibility encodings belong in later contract plans.
The Gecko embedding candidate remains deferred to a bounded future spike.

Scenarios.Scenario: A portable feature requests page observation and receives an explicit profile response before activation.
A CEF-only feature declares an engine extension and is rejected on another runtime rather than silently degraded.
